entries.2dd1038b9a9330db: This business develops, operates, manages and runs shopping centers, among other activities. Its core is PARCO Co., Ltd., which operates Shibuya PARCO, Ikebukuro PARCO, Nagoya PARCO, Shinsaibashi PARCO, etc. External revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥66,027 million.

entries.53f8205e57811571: This is the department store business, selling apparel, miscellaneous goods, household goods and food, among others. Its core is Daimaru Matsuzakaya Department Stores Co., Ltd., which operates stores at Daimaru (Osaka Shinsaibashi, Umeda, Tokyo, Kyoto, Kobe, etc.), Matsuzakaya (Nagoya, Ueno, Shizuoka, etc.) and GINZA SIX. Hakata Daimaru Co., Ltd. (including its Fukuoka Tenjin store, etc.) and Kochi Daimaru Co., Ltd. are also included in this business. External revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥267,744 million, the largest of the five segments.
entries.6eb5903c5b99aef0: This business develops, sells, manages and operates real estate, and carries out interior construction, among other activities. J. Front Urban Development Co., Ltd., J. Front Prime Space Co., Ltd., J. Front Kensou Co., Ltd. and PARCO Space Systems Co., Ltd., among others, are responsible for it. Of these, J. Front Kensou Co., Ltd. and PARCO Space Systems Co., Ltd. were absorbed into J. Front Prime Space Co., Ltd. through merger on March 1, 2026. External revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥60,198 million.
